candidates.title: A simplified economic model for inertial fusion (Hawker, Philosophical Transactions A, 2020)
candidates.notes: Open access on PMC. Technology-agnostic IFE economic model. Quantifies driver cost ($2–10/J), target cost ($1–100), LCOE range down to $25/MWh with optimistic inputs. Gain requirement thresholds analyzed. Full text accessible.

candidates.title: LLNL releases Generalized Economics Model for Fusion Energy (LLNL, January 2026)
candidates.notes: Describes the publicly available GEM tool for IFE LCOE calculations. DPSSL + indirect-drive focus. No quantitative results in article itself but documents existence and availability of the LLNL IFE economic modeling tool. Accessible.

candidates.title: Economic Systems Modeling for Laser IFE and the Potential Advantages of Fast Ignition (Meier, HAPL/LLNL)
candidates.notes: OSTI full PDF accessible. Directly compares fast ignition vs. central hot spot ignition LCOE/COE. Reports ~37% capital cost reduction for fast ignition. Part of HAPL program systems code work. Most targeted source for G-14.
